request: can you make me a little converter from kilometres to miles? type a distance, press Convert, and it should say how many miles that is, to two decimals
design_rationale: A converter is a quick one-shot task, so it is one compact card: a heading, a single labelled box, a full-width Convert button and the result in larger type underneath.

verify.steps: Open the page and see Enter a distance, convert 10 and see 10 km is 6.21 miles, then convert abc and see That is not a number.

why.components/KmPanel.jac: The whole screen: heading, the Kilometres box, the Convert button and the result line, with its state and handlers.
why.main.jac: Loads global.css and renders the converter.

write_reasoning.components/KmPanel.jac: State is has fields (the box text and the result line) and the handler is a plain def, because nothing is awaited. The text is turned into a number with float() inside try/except in a helper that returns in both branches, so no local is declared inside a block.
write_reasoning.main.jac: This app is client-only, so there is no services/ folder and main.jac has no services import. It only loads global.css and returns the panel, and one screen needs no router.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with no saved data, so a single component and no server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: heading, a Kilometres text box, a Convert button and a result line. All state lives in the component as has fields; nothing is saved, so there is no server module. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan: a single-screen client-only tool, 2 files leaf-first, no server.
journal:
# Agent journal

## Issues
- None so far: the app is client-only, so there are no endpoints to register or await.

## Learnings
- The box text is parsed with float() inside try/except; any failure shows That is not a number.
- Numbers are shown the way the calculator shows them: whole values without a decimal, others with round(n, 2).

## Last Action
Built the converter: a Kilometres box, a Convert button and a result line that starts as Enter a distance.
final:
The converter is running: type a distance in Kilometres and press Convert to see the miles to two decimals; text that is not a number says so.

**Next steps**
- Add a miles to kilometres switch
- Convert on Enter
- Keep a short history of conversions
